God of the Forge.description: +25% Production toward Ancient and Classical military units (Civ 6).

Fertility Rites.description: +10% city growth (Civ 6; GS's free Builder is not modelled).

Religious Settlements.description: Border growth 15% cheaper (Civ 6: +15% border expansion; GS's free Settler is not modelled).

City Patron Goddess.description: +25% Production toward districts in cities without a specialty district (Civ 6).

Goddess of the Hunt.description: +1 Food and +1 Production from Camps (Civ 6 GS).

God of Craftsmen.description: +1 Production and +1 Faith from improved strategic resources (Civ 6 GS).

Desert Folklore.description: Holy Site +1 Faith per adjacent Desert tile (Civ 6).

Dance of the Aurora.description: Holy Site +1 Faith per adjacent Tundra tile (Civ 6).

Sacred Path.description: Holy Site +1 Faith per adjacent Rainforest tile (Civ 6).

Tithe.description: +1 Gold per city following this religion (Civ 6).

Pilgrimage.description: +2 Faith per foreign city following this religion (Civ 6).

World Church.description: +1 Culture per city following this religion (Civ 6).

Cross-Cultural Dialogue.description: +1 Science per foreign city following this religion (Civ 6).

Work Ethic.description: Holy Site adjacency also paid as Production (Civ 6).

Choral Music.description: Holy Site adjacency also paid as Culture (Civ 6).

Scholars' Patron.description: Half the Campus adjacency also paid as Culture (ours, #93: science gives culture).

Feed the World.description: +2 Food in follower cities with a Shrine (Civ 6: Shrines and Temples give Food).

Religious Community.description: +1 Housing from the Shrine and +1 from the Temple (Civ 6).

Zen Meditation.description: +1 Amenity in follower cities with at least 2 specialty districts (Civ 6).

Jesuit Education.description: Campus and Theater Square buildings may be bought with Faith (Civ 6).

Divine Inspiration.description: +4 Faith per complete wonder in the city (Civ 6).

Itinerant Preachers.description: Pressure reaches 3 tiles further (Civ 6: +30% range; both range and citizen_weight rise, v3 fixes L3).

Missionary Zeal.description: Directed spread adds 50% more pressure (ours, for Civ 6's Missionary bonuses).

Holy Order.description: Spreading and inquisitions cost 30% less Faith (Civ 6).

Crusade.description: +10 Combat Strength attacking a city (or fortified district) of another or no religion (Civ 6).

Defender of the Faith.description: +5 Combat Strength for units on tiles owned by a city following this religion, attacking or defending (Civ 6).
